August 3rd 1918

Sir,
General Yang, Military Governor of Shanghai, entertained General Loo Yoong Ziang, Deputy Military Governor to tiffin at Lungwha on 2nd inst. After the tiffin the former asked the latter if there were any truth in the stories regarding his plotting with General Chang Hsun and the pro-Manchu party. It is said that General Loo became indignant, refused to answer, and left without saying goodbye.
It is reported that Sun Yat Sen is sending men to Canton to assist in the attack on Lung Chi Kwong.
The memorial service in honour of Chen Chi Mei has been proposed till 13th instant and will be held in the International Institute.
The Chinese Medical association and School teachers Association entertained Yao Ts Zang姚子让M.P. to dinner in the Pau You Daung保安堂No.160 Nanking Road on 2nd inst. Li Ping Shu李平書 was also invited but being absent in Soochow was unable to attend.

Your Obedient Servant,
（签名）
Chief Detective Inspector.

Captain Superintendent of Police.

（印章：上海工部局警务处，侦探股）
上海工部局。
S. REG
493
4.1.87b
1918年8月3日

先生：

本月2日，上海护军使杨将军在龙华设午宴款待副护军使卢永祥将军。午宴后，前者询问后者，关于其与张勋将军及拥清派密谋的传闻是否属实。据悉，卢将军勃然大怒，拒绝回答，并未告辞便离去。

据报，孙中山正派人前往广州，协助进攻龙济光。

纪念陈其美的追悼会已提议推迟至本月13日举行，地点将在万国商团公会堂（International Institute）。

本月2日，中华医学会与教师协会在南京路160号保安堂宴请国会议员姚子让。李平书亦在受邀之列，但因身在苏州，未能出席。

您顺从的仆人，
（签名）
总探长。

警务处总监。
（批注：K.S.）
